title: Artaxerxes' decree to Ezra in his seventh year (Ezra 7)
summary: Artaxerxes commissions Ezra the scribe to go up to Jerusalem with any Israelites who wish, with gifts for the Temple and authority to appoint judges under the law of God; Ezra leaves Babylon on 1 Nisan and arrives on 1 Ab of the king's seventh year.
external_reason: Candidate starting point for Dan 9:25 (Newton; Miller; Guzik lists it, 458 BC).

scripture_extraction.reason: External to Daniel: researched as a candidate starting point of Dan 9:25; Ezra is not yet extracted chapter by chapter.
